title: The Tio family and Sophisticated Lady
summary: Her father knew all the Tios; a man on London Avenue told her his brother Lorenzo wrote Sophisticated Lady and Mood Indigo, and Russell recalls Bigard saying the same.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
